label: Update work item
description: Keep the autonomous work tracker accurate as each item starts, completes, or becomes blocked.

parameter_descriptions.id: The exact stable ID returned by create_work_plan or read_work_plan. Unknown IDs do not create items; read the plan and correct the ID instead.
parameter_descriptions.status: pending to defer or reopen work, in_progress when working, completed for finished work, or blocked for work that cannot proceed. Pending and in_progress items keep the run going.
parameter_descriptions.summary: A concise honest result, progress update, or blocker. Completed and blocked require a nonblank outcome; pending and in_progress may use an empty string.
